capabilities: Convert a copied image with math to LaTeX or Markdown
Choose between Texify, SimpleTex, and pix2tex OCR providers
Run a command to generate LaTeX from the last clipboard image
Insert a loading indicator while converting
Configure self-hosted or hosted OCR service URLs and tokens
extras: Using any provider requires setup outside Obsidian: SimpleTex needs an API token from a developer account, while Texify and pix2tex must be self-hosted (Docker does not work on ARM Macs). The first Texify request is slow because the model loads. A planned feature to convert already pasted images is not implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a screenshot of a formula back into editable LaTeX or Markdown math code.

relations.evidence: Texify (Recomended) - Self Hosted service that convert your image to Markdown
SimpleTex - Hosted service that converts converts your image to Latex wrapped in Math Block
pix2tex - Self Hosted service that converts your image to Latex wrapped in Math Block

summary: Math OCR plugin that converts a clipboard image containing math into LaTeX or Markdown text via Texify, SimpleTex, or pix2tex providers.
